def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

def fixed_sources(names):

            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')
            result[name] = raw
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'', 'whole Git source protocol')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    return result


def metrics(sources):
    rows = {}
    for name, raw in sources.items():
        lines = raw.split(b'\n')
        widths = [len(line[:-1] if index < len(lines)-1 and line.endswith(b'\r') else line)
                  for index, line in enumerate(lines)]
        rows[name] = dict(**pin(raw), lines=raw.count(b'\n'), line_bytes=max(widths, default=0))
    return dict(members=rows, metrics=dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_total=sum(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), bytes_each=max(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_each=max(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), line_bytes_each=max(r['line_bytes'] for r in rows.values())))

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os

from common import *


def fixed_json(path):

def roots():

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path

    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)

    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))

    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

"""Original reader execution; the terminal guard receipt writer stays outside the guarded tree."""
import argparse,subprocess,sys
from common import *

def specs():
    raw=local(PRIOR/"qualification-plan.json").read_bytes();value=json.loads(raw)
    need(raw==canonical(value),"complete canonical original prerequisite plan")
    return value["specifications"]

def instrument(spec):
    return {arg:dict(body=(body:=local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(),identity=pin(body))
            for arg in spec["command"] if Path(arg).is_file()}

def filename(attempt,name,suffix):
    need(attempt.isalnum() and name in specs(),"explicit safe original reader role/attempt")
    return "reader-"+attempt+"-"+name+suffix

def qualify(row,spec):
    need(type(row["status"]) is int and row["status"]==0 and row["command"]==spec["command"]
         and row["specification"]==spec and row["revision"]==REVISION
         and row["programmes"]==row["programmes_after"]==programs()
         and row["direct_instruments"]==row["direct_instruments_after"]==instrument(spec),
         "actual unchanged original command, status and complete execution source epoch")
    need(row["stderr"]=="" and spec["match"] in ("whole","terminal")
         and (row["stdout"]==spec["stdout"] if spec["match"]=="whole" else row["stdout"].endswith(spec["stdout"])),
         "complete declared original success stream role")
    for s in ("stdout","stderr"):
        need(local(row[s+"_path"]).read_bytes()==row[s].encode(),"whole retained actual native reader stream")

def child(attempt,name):
    spec=specs()[name];row=load(filename(attempt,name,"-started.json"))
    need(row["specification"]==spec and row["programmes"]==programs(),"whole declared reader and execution programme epoch before child")
    with local(row["stdout_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as out,local(row["stderr_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as err:
        result=subprocess.run(spec["command"],stdout=out,stderr=err)
    actual=dict(**row,status=result.returncode,stdout=local(row["stdout_path"]).read_text(),stderr=local(row["stderr_path"]).read_text(),
                programmes_after=programs(),direct_instruments_after=instrument(spec))
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-actual.json"),actual)
    qualify(actual,spec)
    print("PASS complete unchanged original prerequisite",name)

def execute(attempt,name):
    spec=specs()[name]
    need(programs()==load("execution-plan.json")["programmes"],"complete frozen original-reader execution dependency set")
    row=dict(command=spec["command"],specification=spec,revision=REVISION,owner=LEAF,scope=SCOPE,
        programmes=programs(),direct_instruments=instrument(spec),source=pin(local(BASE/"intake-before.json").read_bytes()),
        stdout_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,".stdout.txt")),stderr_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,".stderr.txt")),
        condition="Original unchanged reader only. Native result is not fully source-qualified until whole after-corpus custody also succeeds. First A/B failures remain non-success.")
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-started.json"),row)
    command=["scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh","--","python3","-B",str(BASE/"capture.py"),"--child","--attempt",attempt,"--name",name]
    outer=dict(command=command,programmes=programs(),specification=spec,
        stdout_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,"-guard.stdout.txt")),stderr_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,"-guard.stderr.txt")),
        condition="This writer is outside the guarded process tree. Every terminal guard code and complete available stream retains before judgment.")
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-guard-started.json"),outer)
    with local(outer["stdout_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as out,local(outer["stderr_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as err:
        result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=out,stderr=err)
    actual=dict(**outer,status=result.returncode,stdout=local(outer["stdout_path"]).read_text(),stderr=local(outer["stderr_path"]).read_text(),
                programmes_after=programs(),native_stdout=local(row["stdout_path"]).read_text() if Path(row["stdout_path"]).exists() else None,
                native_stderr=local(row["stderr_path"]).read_text() if Path(row["stderr_path"]).exists() else None)
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-guard-actual.json"),actual)
    print("original guarded reader",name,"status",result.returncode,flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0 and actual["programmes"]==actual["programmes_after"]==programs(),
         "actual successful unchanged original guarded reader; every interrupted attempt is non-success")
    qualify(load(filename(attempt,name,"-actual.json")),spec)

if __name__=="__main__":
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument("--child",action="store_true");parser.add_argument("--attempt",required=True);parser.add_argument("--name",required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    (child if args.child else execute)(args.attempt,args.name)

import subprocess

def update(name, row, replace=False):
    records = load('checks.json') if (BASE / 'checks.json').exists() else {}
    need((name in records) == replace, 'retain first complete external gate result')
    records[name] = row
    local(BASE / 'checks.json', exists=False).write_bytes(canonical(records))

    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'named explicit external gate command')
    name, inner = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
    need(name and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in name), 'plain external gate label')
    folder = local(Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-reader-completion-20261011/checks') / name, exists=False)
    need(not folder.exists(), 'fresh first external stream directory')
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *inner]
    epoch = instruments()
    inputs = {p: row['identity'] for p, row in epoch.items()}
    for arg in inner:
        if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file():
            inputs[arg] = pin(local(arg).read_bytes())
    for path in ('scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', 'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',

        inputs[path] = pin(local(path).read_bytes())
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'

        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),

    update(name, started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    after = {p: pin(local(p).read_bytes()) for p in inputs}

        inputs_after=after, programmes_after=after_epoch, epoch_conserved=inputs == after and epoch == after_epoch)
    update(name, actual, replace=True)

    need(actual['epoch_conserved'] is True, 'whole unchanged external programme/source epoch')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0, 'actual successful external gate: ' + name)

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):
    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain complete first admission source/result: ' + name)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def load(name):
    raw = local(BASE / name).read_bytes()
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical admission record')
    return value


def save_product(name, value):
    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain complete first compressed candidate: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(value), mtime=0))


def product(name):
    raw = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / name).read_bytes())
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical decompressed candidate')
    return value


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))


def programs():
    return {str(path): dict(body=(raw := local(path).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw))
            for path in [BASE / name for name in ('capture.py', 'common.py', 'intake.py')]}


def fixed_sources(names):
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    result = {}
    try:
        for name in sorted(names):
            need('\n' not in name and ':' not in name and not name.startswith('/'), 'safe complete Git source member')
            process.stdin.write((REVISION + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'complete fixed source blob')
            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')
            result[name] = raw
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'', 'whole Git source protocol')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    return result


def metrics(sources):
    rows = {}
    for name, raw in sources.items():
        lines = raw.split(b'\n')
        widths = [len(line[:-1] if index < len(lines)-1 and line.endswith(b'\r') else line)
                  for index, line in enumerate(lines)]
        rows[name] = dict(**pin(raw), lines=raw.count(b'\n'), line_bytes=max(widths, default=0))
    return dict(members=rows, metrics=dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_total=sum(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), bytes_each=max(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_each=max(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), line_bytes_each=max(r['line_bytes'] for r in rows.values())))

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

    vm, total = record['commands']
    need(vm['command'] == ['vm_stat'] and total['command'] == ['sysctl', '-n', 'hw.memsize']
         and all(type(r['status']) is int and r['status'] == 0 and r['stderr'] == ''
                 and type(r['stdout']) is str for r in (vm, total)),
         'complete actual native occupied-capacity inputs')
    page = int(re.search(r'page size of ([0-9]+)', vm['stdout'])[1])
    values = {}
    for line in vm['stdout'].splitlines()[1:]:
        name, separator, value = line.partition(':')
        if separator and value.strip().rstrip('.').isdigit():
            values[name] = int(value.strip().rstrip('.'))
    positive = ('Pages active', 'Pages inactive', 'Pages speculative', 'Pages wired down',
                'Pages occupied by compressor')
    negative = ('Pages purgeable', 'File-backed pages')
    used = sum(values[k] for k in positive) - sum(values[k] for k in negative)
    capacity = int(total['stdout'])
    percent = used * page * 100 / capacity
    need(record['page_size'] == page and record['total_bytes'] == capacity
         and record['counters'] == {k: values[k] for k in (*positive, *negative)}
         and 0 <= percent <= 100 and type(record['occupied_percent']) is float

def specs():
    raw=local(PRIOR/"qualification-plan.json").read_bytes();value=json.loads(raw)

def instrument(spec):
    return {arg:dict(body=(body:=local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(),identity=pin(body))
            for arg in spec["command"] if Path(arg).is_file()}

def filename(attempt,name,suffix):
    need(attempt.isalnum() and name in specs(),"explicit safe original reader role/attempt")
    return "reader-"+attempt+"-"+name+suffix

def qualify(row,spec):
    need(type(row["status"]) is int and row["status"]==0 and row["command"]==spec["command"]
         and row["specification"]==spec and row["revision"]==REVISION
         and row["programmes"]==row["programmes_after"]==programs()
         and row["direct_instruments"]==row["direct_instruments_after"]==instrument(spec),
         "actual unchanged original command, status and complete execution source epoch")
    need(row["stderr"]=="" and spec["match"] in ("whole","terminal")
         and (row["stdout"]==spec["stdout"] if spec["match"]=="whole" else row["stdout"].endswith(spec["stdout"])),
         "complete declared original success stream role")
    for s in ("stdout","stderr"):
        need(local(row[s+"_path"]).read_bytes()==row[s].encode(),"whole retained actual native reader stream")

def child(attempt,name):
    spec=specs()[name];row=load(filename(attempt,name,"-started.json"))

    with local(row["stdout_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as out,local(row["stderr_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as err:
        result=subprocess.run(spec["command"],stdout=out,stderr=err)
    actual=dict(**row,status=result.returncode,stdout=local(row["stdout_path"]).read_text(),stderr=local(row["stderr_path"]).read_text(),
                programmes_after=programs(),direct_instruments_after=instrument(spec))
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-actual.json"),actual)
    qualify(actual,spec)
    print("PASS complete unchanged original prerequisite",name)

def execute(attempt,name):
    spec=specs()[name]
    need(programs()==load("execution-plan.json")["programmes"],"complete frozen original-reader execution dependency set")
    row=dict(command=spec["command"],specification=spec,revision=REVISION,owner=LEAF,scope=SCOPE,

        stdout_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,".stdout.txt")),stderr_path=str(BASE/filename(attempt,name,".stderr.txt")),

    save(filename(attempt,name,"-started.json"),row)

        condition="This writer is outside the guarded process tree. Every terminal guard code and complete available stream retains before judgment.")

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):
    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain complete first admission source/result: ' + name)

def load(name):

def save_product(name, value):

def product(name):

def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))


def programs():

            for path in [BASE / name for name in ('capture.py', 'common.py', 'intake.py')]}


def fixed_sources(names):
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],

            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'complete fixed source blob')
            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')
            result[name] = raw
        process.stdin.close()

    return result


def metrics(sources):

        lines = raw.split(b'\n')

        rows[name] = dict(**pin(raw), lines=raw.count(b'\n'), line_bytes=max(widths, default=0))
    return dict(members=rows, metrics=dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_total=sum(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), bytes_each=max(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

def execution_source(spec):
    return {arg: dict(body=(raw := local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw))
            for arg in spec['command'] if Path(arg).is_file()}


def qualify_reader(row, spec, epoch, revision, source=None):
    need(type(row.get('status')) is int and row['status'] == 0, 'actual typed successful original reader status')
    need(row['command'] == spec['command'] and row['specification'] == spec,
         'whole unchanged original reader command and declared role')
    need(row.get('revision', row.get('source_revision')) == revision,
         'explicit original reader source revision')
    need(row['programmes'] == row['programmes_after'] == epoch
         and row['direct_instruments'] == row['direct_instruments_after'] == execution_source(spec),
         'whole actual original reader programme epoch')
    need(type(row['stdout']) is str and row['stderr'] == '' and spec['match'] in ('whole', 'terminal')
         and (row['stdout'] == spec['stdout'] if spec['match'] == 'whole'
              else row['stdout'].endswith(spec['stdout'])), 'whole declared original reader success stream')
    for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        need(local(row[stream + '_path']).read_bytes() == row[stream].encode(),
             'whole tracked original reader native stream bytes')
    if source is not None:
        need(row['source'] == source and row['owner'] == LEAF and row['scope'] == SCOPE,
             'whole admitted C reader source and finite owner')


def allocate(mapping, specs):
    need(set(mapping) == set(specs), 'every complete original reader role allocated exactly once')
    paths = [row['receipt'] for row in mapping.values()]
    need(len(paths) == len(set(paths)), 'unique complete original reader result allocation')
    for name, row in mapping.items():
        need(row['specification'] == specs[name], 'complete original reader role conserves')


def controls(specs, mapping, source):
    """Real changed candidates exercise the same acceptance predicates."""
    import copy
    plan = load('execution-plan.json')
    name = plan['remaining'][0]
    spec = specs[name]
    original = read(BASE / ('reader-C-' + name + '-actual.json'))
    cases = []
    candidates = [
        ('boolean-status', 'actual typed successful original reader status',
         lambda v: v.update(status=False)),
        ('omitted-terminal-status', 'actual typed successful original reader status',
         lambda v: v.pop('status')),
        ('changed-original-command', 'whole unchanged original reader command and declared role',
         lambda v: v.update(command=spec['command'] + ['--invented'])),
        ('borrowed-source-revision', 'explicit original reader source revision',
         lambda v: v.update(revision=plan['revision'][:-1] + '0')),
        ('missing-native-source', 'whole admitted C reader source and finite owner',
         lambda v: v.update(source={})),
    ]
    for label, reason, mutate in candidates:
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(original)
        mutate(candidate)
        try:
            qualify_reader(candidate, spec, plan['programmes'], REVISION, source)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error) == reason, 'genuine control reaches intended original checkpoint predicate')
            cases.append(dict(name=label, candidate=candidate, refusal=str(error)))
        else:
            raise ValueError('hostile checkpoint candidate was accepted: ' + label)
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(mapping)
    candidate.pop(name)
    try:
        allocate(candidate, specs)
    except ValueError as error:
        need(str(error) == 'every complete original reader role allocated exactly once',
             'genuine complete-corpus omission reaches intended predicate')
        cases.append(dict(name='omitted-original-reader', candidate=candidate, refusal=str(error)))
    else:
        raise ValueError('incomplete original corpus was accepted')
    qualify_reader(original, spec, plan['programmes'], REVISION, source)
    return cases


def gate(name, command, success=None):
    row = load('checks.json')[name]
    need(row['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and type(row.get('status')) is int and row['status'] == 0
         and row['programmes'] == row['programmes_after'] == instruments()
             == load('qualification-plan.json')['programmes']
         and row['inputs'] == row['inputs_after'] and row['epoch_conserved'] is True,
         'actual complete external checkpoint gate command/status/source epoch: ' + name)
    need(type(row['stdout']) is str and type(row['stderr']) is str and re.match(
        r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n',
        row['stderr']) is not None and 'ram-guard: host memory' not in row['stderr']
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in row['stderr'],
         'complete actual standard RAM-guard diagnostic without cutoff')
    if success is not None:
        need(row['stdout'] == success and row['stderr'].count('\n') == 1,
             'complete intended predecessor success: ' + name)
    for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        path = local(row[stream + '_path'], exists=False)
        need(str(path).startswith('.artifacts/raw-semantic-reader-completion-20261011/checks/'),
             'own optional same-volume external stream materialization')

def defaults():
    # These exact original declarations are themselves admitted from fixed Git.
    text = fixed_sources([str(PRIOR / 'verify.py')])[str(PRIOR / 'verify.py')].decode()
    import ast
    module = ast.parse(text)
    declaration = next(n.value for n in module.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                       and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'DEFAULTS' for t in n.targets))
    constants = {'ADMISSION': ADMISSION, 'PRIOR': ASSOCIATION, 'CONSTRUCTION': CONSTRUCTION,
                 'REPAIR': REPAIR, 'CUSTODY': CUSTODY, 'SEMANTIC': SEMANTIC}
    return eval(compile(ast.Expression(declaration), str(PRIOR / 'verify.py'), 'eval'),
                {'__builtins__': {}}, constants)


def resource_record(record, rounded=False):
    vm, total = record['commands']
    need(vm['command'] == ['vm_stat'] and total['command'] == ['sysctl', '-n', 'hw.memsize']
         and all(type(r['status']) is int and r['status'] == 0 and r['stderr'] == ''
                 and type(r['stdout']) is str for r in (vm, total)),
         'complete actual native occupied-capacity inputs')
    page = int(re.search(r'page size of ([0-9]+)', vm['stdout'])[1])
    values = {}
    for line in vm['stdout'].splitlines()[1:]:
        name, separator, value = line.partition(':')
        if separator and value.strip().rstrip('.').isdigit():
            values[name] = int(value.strip().rstrip('.'))
    positive = ('Pages active', 'Pages inactive', 'Pages speculative', 'Pages wired down',
                'Pages occupied by compressor')
    negative = ('Pages purgeable', 'File-backed pages')
    used = sum(values[k] for k in positive) - sum(values[k] for k in negative)
    capacity = int(total['stdout'])
    percent = used * page * 100 / capacity
    need(record['page_size'] == page and record['total_bytes'] == capacity
         and record['counters'] == {k: values[k] for k in (*positive, *negative)}
         and 0 <= percent <= 100 and type(record['occupied_percent']) is float
         and record['occupied_percent'] == (round(percent, 1) if rounded else percent),
         'independent whole native occupied-capacity rederivation; no inferred interrupted peak')

def authority(before, tasks, books, after):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in before.splitlines()]
    measured = metrics(tasks)['metrics']
    for row in rows:
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            need(row['state'] == 'warning_debt' and measured['lines_each'] < 7200,
                 'bounded owned checkpoint task evidence')
            for key, value in measured.items():
                need(value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key], 'unchanged task collection ceilings')
                row['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0,
                    value + row['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - row['baseline'][key])
        elif row.get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior':
            baseline = metrics(books)['metrics']
            current = dict(books)
            current[BOOK] = after
            result = metrics(current)['metrics']
            keys = ('files', 'bytes_total', 'lines_total')
            row['reference_contract']['aggregate_change'] = dict(
                authority_id='RAW-ORIGINAL-READER-CHECKPOINT-20261011', owner=LEAF,
                baseline={k: baseline[k] for k in keys},
                delta={k: result[k] - baseline[k] for k in keys},
                rationale='Replace only the earlier partial-reader notice with complete unchanged original-reader checkpoint status. Stream recovery and full original parent acceptance remain open; no ceilings widen.')
    return b''.join(canonical(row) for row in rows)

def need(condition, message):

    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):

    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

def controls(specs, mapping, source):
    """Real changed candidates exercise the same acceptance predicates."""
    import copy
    plan = load('execution-plan.json')
    name = plan['remaining'][0]
    spec = specs[name]
    original = read(BASE / ('reader-C-' + name + '-actual.json'))
    cases = []
    candidates = [
        ('boolean-status', 'actual typed successful original reader status',
         lambda v: v.update(status=False)),
        ('omitted-terminal-status', 'actual typed successful original reader status',
         lambda v: v.pop('status')),
        ('changed-original-command', 'whole unchanged original reader command and declared role',
         lambda v: v.update(command=spec['command'] + ['--invented'])),
        ('borrowed-source-revision', 'explicit original reader source revision',
         lambda v: v.update(revision=plan['revision'][:-1] + '0')),
        ('missing-native-source', 'whole admitted C reader source and finite owner',
         lambda v: v.update(source={})),
    ]
    for label, reason, mutate in candidates:
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(original)
        mutate(candidate)
        try:
            qualify_reader(candidate, spec, plan['programmes'], REVISION, source)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error) == reason, 'genuine control reaches intended original checkpoint predicate')
            cases.append(dict(name=label, candidate=candidate, refusal=str(error)))
        else:
            raise ValueError('hostile checkpoint candidate was accepted: ' + label)
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(mapping)
    candidate.pop(name)
    try:
        allocate(candidate, specs)
    except ValueError as error:
        need(str(error) == 'every complete original reader role allocated exactly once',
             'genuine complete-corpus omission reaches intended predicate')
        cases.append(dict(name='omitted-original-reader', candidate=candidate, refusal=str(error)))
    else:
        raise ValueError('incomplete original corpus was accepted')
    qualify_reader(original, spec, plan['programmes'], REVISION, source)
    return cases

    page = int(re.search(r'page size of ([0-9]+)', vm['stdout'])[1])
    values = {}
    for line in vm['stdout'].splitlines()[1:]:
        name, separator, value = line.partition(':')

                'Pages occupied by compressor')

    capacity = int(total['stdout'])

    need(record['page_size'] == page and record['total_bytes'] == capacity
         and record['counters'] == {k: values[k] for k in (*positive, *negative)}
         and 0 <= percent <= 100 and type(record['occupied_percent']) is float

def need(condition, message):

def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):
    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)

def git(*args):

    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

    return result

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()

            need(len({r['pid'] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
                 and all(all(type(r[k]) is int and r[k] >= 0 for k in ('pid', 'ppid', 'rss_kib'))
                         and type(r['command']) is str for r in rows), 'complete typed passive own-process rows')

        interrupted_C=pin(canonical(cutoff)), passive_D=pin(canonical(observed)),
        observation_limits='Passive PID/parent/RSS and host snapshots do not measure continuous or peak interrupted RSS, native births, or external-process attribution.')


def core():
    complete = corpus()
    preserved = gate('original-retention', RETAIN_COMMAND,
        'PASS complete dated partial-reader evidence preservation; full original corpus, stream recovery and raw parent acceptance remain open.\n')
    default_results = {}
    for timing in ('before', 'after'):
        for role, path, success in defaults():
            default_results[timing + '-' + role] = pin(canonical(gate(timing + '-' + role,
                ['python3', '-B', str(path)], success)))
    return dict(owner=LEAF, **complete, contracts=contracts(),
        preserved_epoch=pin(canonical(preserved)), predecessor_defaults=default_results,
        limits='Every selected complete C/D reader passes the original 88% host / 4096-MiB descendant / 2s guard. '
               'Interrupted peak RSS and the first A outer launch diagnostic remain unmeasured.',
        condition=SCOPE)


def authority(before, tasks, books, after):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in before.splitlines()]
    measured = metrics(tasks)['metrics']
    for row in rows:
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            need(row['state'] == 'warning_debt' and measured['lines_each'] < 7200,
                 'bounded owned checkpoint task evidence')
            for key, value in measured.items():
                need(value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key], 'unchanged task collection ceilings')
                row['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0,
                    value + row['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - row['baseline'][key])
        elif row.get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior':
            baseline = metrics(books)['metrics']
            current = dict(books)
            current[BOOK] = after
            result = metrics(current)['metrics']
            keys = ('files', 'bytes_total', 'lines_total')
            row['reference_contract']['aggregate_change'] = dict(
                authority_id='RAW-ORIGINAL-READER-CHECKPOINT-20261011', owner=LEAF,
                baseline={k: baseline[k] for k in keys},
                delta={k: result[k] - baseline[k] for k in keys},
                rationale='Replace only the earlier partial-reader notice with complete unchanged original-reader checkpoint status. Stream recovery and full original parent acceptance remain open; no ceilings widen.')
    return b''.join(canonical(row) for row in rows)


def publication():
    import publish
    import operation
    actual = load('publication-operation-actual.json')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', 'python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'publish.py')]
         and actual['programmes'] == actual['programmes_after'] == instruments()
         and actual['programme'] == dict(body=local(BASE / 'operation.py').read_text(),
                                         identity=pin(local(BASE / 'operation.py').read_bytes()))
         and actual['programme_after'] == actual['programme']['identity']
         and actual['stdout'] == 'Prepared complete original-reader checkpoint only; stream recovery and full raw acceptance remain open.\n'
         and re.fullmatch(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr']) is not None,
         'complete actual original publication command/source/guard/result epoch')
    for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        need(local(actual[stream + '_path']).read_bytes() == actual[stream].encode(),
             'whole tracked actual publication stream')
    snapshots = {}
    for phase in ('before', 'after'):
        members = actual['sources_' + phase]
        need(set(members) == set(operation.SOURCES), 'complete declared publication mutation source population')
        snapshots[phase] = {}
        for name, entry in members.items():
            body = gzip.decompress(local(entry['snapshot']).read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == {k: entry['identity'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
                 and entry['identity']['executable'] is False, 'whole actual publication source body and mode')
            snapshots[phase][name] = body
    row = load('publication.json')
    before = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'book-before.md.gz').read_bytes())
    after = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'book-after.md.gz').read_bytes())
    old_notice = read(PRIOR / 'book-size-correction-plan.json')['addition'].encode()
    need(before == git('show', REVISION + ':' + BOOK) and before.count(old_notice) == 1
         and after == before.replace(old_notice, publish.ADDITION, 1)
         and snapshots['before'][BOOK] == before and snapshots['after'][BOOK] == after,
         'whole exact sole owned book notice replacement and retained historical context')
    task = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'qualified-task.md.gz').read_bytes())
    need(snapshots['after'][TASK] == task, 'whole actual unchanged-contract task closure source')
    tasks = fixed_sources(row['task_names'])
    tasks[TASK] = task
    books = fixed_sources(row['book_names'])
    registry = git('show', REVISION + ':' + SURFACES)
    need(load('task-census.json') == metrics(tasks)
         and local(BASE / 'registry-before.txt').read_bytes() == registry
         and local(BASE / 'registry-after.txt').read_bytes() == authority(registry, tasks, books, after)
         and snapshots['before'][SURFACES] == registry
         and snapshots['after'][SURFACES] == local(BASE / 'registry-after.txt').read_bytes(),
         'whole measured checkpoint authority without changed ceilings or unrelated surface allowance')
    return dict(contracts=contracts(task), book=pin(after), registry=pin(local(BASE / 'registry-after.txt').read_bytes()),
                actual_operation=pin(canonical(actual)))


def catalog():
    return {p.name: identity(p) for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir())
            if p.name not in ('checks.json', 'manifest.json')}


def full():
    import sequence
    ordered = load('core-sequence-actual.json')
    expected = [[name, command] for name, command in sequence.steps()]
    need(ordered['steps'] == expected and ordered['failure'] is None
         and ordered['programmes'] == ordered['programmes_after'] == instruments()
         and ordered['programme'] == dict(body=local(BASE / 'sequence.py').read_text(),
                                          identity=pin(local(BASE / 'sequence.py').read_bytes()))
         and ordered['programme_after'] == ordered['programme']['identity']
         and ordered['original_D'] == identity(BASE / 'observer-D-actual.json')
         and len(ordered['outcomes']) == len(expected), 'complete actual ordered core qualification and source epoch')
    for outcome, (name, command) in zip(ordered['outcomes'], expected, strict=True):
        need(outcome['name'] == name and outcome['command'] == ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'checks.py'), name, *command]
             and type(outcome['status']) is int and outcome['status'] == 0
             and outcome['stdout'] == name + ' actual status 0\n' and outcome['stderr'] == '',
             'whole actual core step and before/corpus/after ordering')
    external = {}
    for name, command in {'focused': FOCUSED, 'book-build': ['mdbook', 'build', 'docs/book'],
        'current-native': ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', '--build', 'docs/book/book'],
        'size': ['scripts/check_live_document_size.sh'], 'claims': ['scripts/check_claim_verification.pl'],
        'inventory': ['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl']}.items():
        row = gate(name, command)
        if name == 'focused':
            need('All tests successful.' in row['stdout'], 'actual complete focused checkpoint regression success')
        external[name] = pin(canonical(row))
    return dict(checkpoint=core(), publication=publication(), external=external, ordered_core=pin(canonical(ordered)),
        legs=dict(rederive='Independent complete original role allocation, original native stream/programme/source custody and fresh predecessor defaults.',
            falsify='Genuine Boolean status, omitted terminal, changed command, borrowed source, missing source and omitted-reader candidates reject; all first A/B/C guard and fixed-context/missing-stream refusals retain unchanged.',
            durability='Complete actual original A/B/C programmes, commands, products and streams remain tracked under required-history custody. Whole source admission and exact publication/task/authority snapshots are independently sealed. Interrupted peak RSS and first A launch diagnostic are missing measurements, never inferred.'),
        condition=SCOPE)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--core', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--corpus', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()

                 'whole exact complete original-reader checkpoint proof and namespace')
        print(SUCCESS, end='')
